text:
𝗝𝗔𝗖𝗢𝗕𝗦 𝟮𝟬𝟮*! 😳🔥

Bevon Jacobs: 202* off 137 with 21 sixes, a NZ List A record.
Auckland made 334/8 but Otago still chased it down.

Most sixes ever in a day? 👇

#Cricket #FordTrophy
